implementation.read_source_binding: Explicit worktree-relative RepoPath sources are normalized and deduplicated, descriptor-opened component by component with O_NOFOLLOW, limited to same-device regular files with one link, and bound to path, device, inode, UID, GID, mode, link count, size, mtime, ctime, SHA-256, and every ancestor directory identity plus mtime and ctime.
implementation.read_authority_protocol_binding: The canonical read-authority digest and normalized source paths are bound into each invocation, effect intent, request, result artifact, reuse artifact, witness, and protocol identity.
implementation.read_revalidation: Bound source descriptors, content digests, pathname identities, and ancestor identities are revalidated at preparation, request preflight, before reuse acceptance, before execution, after child/report/output capture, and before result or reuse minting. Mutation or replacement returns incomplete recovery-required mediation after spawn and cannot mint a result or reuse artifact.
implementation.sandbox_read_policy: Seatbelt denies file-read by default. It allows the exact pinned program, exact bound source literals including canonical /private aliases, exact output-scope metadata needed for writes, the root directory literal required by dyld startup, and immutable system runtime roots /System, /usr/lib, and /private/var/db/dyld.
implementation.startup_loader_environment_policy: Known shell, language-runtime, JVM, Node, Perl, PHP, Python, Ruby, ELF, and Darwin startup-loader environment keys are refused during invocation binding before authority or spawn.
implementation.process_exec_policy: After sandbox activation process-exec remains denied by default and allowed only for the literal pinned executable path used for launch.
implementation.file_map_executable_policy: file-map-executable remains denied by default; only immutable system-library roots /System and /usr/lib are allowed for platform dynamic startup.
implementation.process_fork_policy: process-fork remains denied with send-signal SIGKILL.

The supported execution model is macOS Seatbelt and one process. Process creation kills the runner.

Unbound reads and external interpreted sources are unsupported. Bound sources are limited to 128 worktree-relative, same-device, one-link regular files totaling at most 64 MiB; directories, symlinks, hardlinks, and special files are refused.
Source ancestor ctime is deliberately pinned. Concurrent directory churn can therefore cause a safe false refusal.
Read-authority validation rehashes up to 64 MiB at multiple pre/post execution and reuse boundaries; this is bounded O(total bound source bytes) overhead.

The root directory literal, immutable system runtime roots, exact pinned program, bound source literals, and exact output-scope metadata/write paths remain deliberate read-policy exceptions; system roots are not individually digest-pinned.

Final executable launch and child source open are pathname-based. A more privileged post-preflight race is not excluded, and a child may cause an external effect before post-spawn revalidation refuses result and reuse minting.
Apple /bin/sh remains unsupported because it substitutes /bin/bash after sandbox activation.
RoutineRootGrant has no production issuer, and process-local grant, artifact, and recovery state is lost on crash or restart.
